string-array.name: changelog_notes
string-array.item: Onboarding, QR codes and invite links, blocked users, account deletion with data export, help center, feedback, quiet hours, timed mutes, share to MENCH, shortcuts and a Quick Settings tile.
Photo compression, tuned caches, smarter retry of failed messages with upload progress, connection banner and faster reconnects.
Branded dialogs, menus and sheets, Persian-first typography and a new splash screen.
